warnings.why: A value of 10 percent of annual sales lost to outages is implausibly low for Chad, which suffers from severe and chronic electricity shortages and very frequent outages.
A value of 10 percent is extremely low given the severe energy crisis and frequent blackouts affecting businesses in Mali.
A value of 9 percent is inconsistent with the catastrophic state of the power grid and generation capacity in the Central African Republic.
A value of 2 percent is far too low for Bangladesh, where industrial and commercial sectors frequently complain of crippling power outages and rely heavily on diesel generators.
